summary: Raised from the docs-site side while writing the 1.3.0 pages: the copy tells users to "hit Remove" for object removal and there is no Remove. Verified absent, not merely unfound - no remove: key in commandRegistry.js, models.js itself lists remove under deprecated/never wired, and grep for a Remove label across js/ returns only Remove Background (a different BiRefNet tool, which is the trap: a user hunting for Remove finds it and gets the inverse). The real path is mask -> inpaint -> EMPTY prompt, which inpaint.help already states correctly, so the ? guide and the Model Library tile contradict each other. Three sites: models.js:529 is the urgent one because it is live UI a user reads while deciding to install Klein, not a changelog; releaseNotes.js:49 and the 2026-07-30-v1.3.0.md mirror are changelogs and their correction is a recorded judgement call. Docs site already ships the correct procedure (Cubric-Studio-Docs 04a400b), so the fix is entirely app-side.

Picked up. The urgent site is fixed: models.js klein-4b description now reads 'mask an object, run Inpaint with the prompt left empty' instead of 'hit Remove'. DECISION RECORDED on the changelog judgement call - releaseNotes.js['1.3.0'] and the 2026-07-30-v1.3.0.md mirror were CORRECTED too, not left as historical record: the in-app changelog is live UI every user reads, and a rendered instruction to press a control that does not exist is a defect wherever it renders. What shipped is preserved in git and in an explicit correction note appended to the release doc's Platform Update Checklist. Grep across js/ confirms no other user-facing string instructs a Remove control; the only Remove labels left are Remove Background (BiRefNet, unrelated) and slot/point clear buttons. Remaining: the Patreon and Discord 1.3.0 posts are the one acceptance item an agent cannot check - the release doc now carries the corrected wording and an instruction to fix any post that already went out with the old sentence.

DONE. All three sites now name the real path - mask an object, run Inpaint with the prompt left empty - in models.js:529 (Model Library tile, the live-UI one), releaseNotes.js['1.3.0'] (in-app changelog) and the 2026-07-30-v1.3.0.md mirror. Shipped in ca0eb45e. The changelog judgement call was DECIDED, not assumed: both changelogs were corrected rather than preserved as historical record, because a changelog that renders in the app is live UI and an instruction to press a control that does not exist is a defect wherever it renders; what shipped is kept in git plus an explicit correction note appended to the release doc's Platform Update Checklist. Grep across js/ confirms no user-facing string instructs a Remove control - the only Remove labels left are Remove Background (BiRefNet, unrelated) and slot/point clear buttons. Acceptance item 4 resolved by the user 2026-08-01: the Patreon and Discord 1.3.0 posts have NOT gone out, so nothing downstream repeats the claim; the announcements are carded in the MadPony-Identity repo as its MPI-67 - social is that repo's domain, not this one. Docs site needed nothing (Cubric-Studio-Docs 04a400b already documents the real three-step procedure).
